head: e5bfccb17d5c13a21f6fb56e8b71a14b7ab548a2
scope: ywz65's peak-four three-source XOR fanout theorem extends Hanson Sun's PR1520 construction. Reviewed monotone integer-lift argument: final targets cannot be polluted, restored helpers cannot carry three helper columns at peak four, and every target needs two gates plus two helper writes (or three direct writes). Attaining word and reversal establish exactly2n+2 for all n>=2 and arbitrary extra dirty roles. Independent truth tables/column envelopes support the proof; n=1 and peak-five controls retained. Not an unconstrained XOR minimum or native precision admission.
